rules.title: Fair Chance Ordinance
rules.requirement: Landlords in affordable housing cannot deny an applicant based on arrest or conviction history, with certain protections for people with criminal records applying for affordable housing.
rules.coverage_conditions: Applies to affordable housing decisions in San Francisco involving applicants with arrest or conviction history.
rules.quoted_span: San Francisco's Fair Chance Ordinance protects residents with arrest or conviction history in affordable housing decisions.

coverage.other_unknown_factor: whether the unit is subsidized/deed-restricted affordable housing
